summary: Map edges examined and rejected in the round-3 Fourth Way batch. (1) Grades to a maximum at being from more-such-has and excluded middle alone: refuted by the Lean-checked natural-numbers model (Control.gradesAscent.omit_hWF), in which everything has being, each number is more a being than smaller ones, and there is no maximum; an ascent bound or a primary is needed. (2) Strict calibration from STMT-HOMOGENEOUS-BEING-SCALE: that reading orders beings by a preorder on the beings, not by the frame's value map; a bridge would have the form of STMT-DEGREE-AS-MUCH-AS-APPROACH, and the homogeneous scale is a stipulated contrast, not Aquinas's reading. (3) Greatest-degree genus principle from STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH: wrong direction (cause to more such, not most such to cause). (4) Maximal genus principle from STMT-EXCEEDED-PERFECTION-IS-CAUSED (SCG II.15): it gives some cause distinct from the exceeded bearer, not the maximum as that cause; the closing bridge would state the conclusion. (5) More-such-has-the-perfection from the approach order alone: the order constrains comparisons by nearness, not possession by the exceeding side (two beings, the primary has r, a non-primary exceeds another without r; not Lean-checked as a separate model). (6) As-to-being-so-to-truth from STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING: transfers maximality only, constrains neither having nor the comparative, and runs the other way in the quarta via. Rejection records that a lead was examined; it neither refutes nor establishes any target.
